sentences.text: You’re legally responsible for your wake and any damage or injury it causes, so slow down near docks, small boats and anchored vessels.
Within five hundred yards of a large American naval vessel, you must operate at minimum speed, and you may not come within one hundred yards without permission.
Many Florida ports enforce security zones around cruise ships, tankers and port facilities.
Florida law also covers boating under the influence and reckless operation.
And when the Coast Guard or the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission signals you to stop for a boarding, comply promptly.
